content.text:
**Defining Grid Structure**

I've established the foundation: a 9x9 grid. I've also implemented dividers to group the subgrids. Specifically, column dividers are placed at 9 and 19. Also, I have a row divider at 9. I'm currently working on representing the data, specifically the top middle subgrid, row by row. This should help me manage and index the subgrid data.
